lessons.claim: A dilute suspension of spheres is exactly Newtonian (if the flow cannot change the microstructure it is Newtonian). mu*/mu = 1 + 2.5 phi + K* phi^2, and for hard-sphere Brownian K* = 6.2 (Batchelor 1977: direct Brownian 0.97 + hydrodynamic 5.2), refined to 5.91 (Brady-Vicic 1995). ★ The phi^2 term reaches 10% of the Einstein term at phi = 4.0%, so above phi>4% 'it is dilute so it is Newtonian' is already broken at the 10% level
